title: Best Macramé Wall Hangings to Transform Any Room
excerpt: Macramé is back in a big way. We curated the most stunning handwoven wall hangings that add instant warmth and texture to your space.

props.text: Why Macramé is the Ultimate Boho Statement

If you are looking to add warmth, texture, and a bohemian vibe to your living room or bedroom, a large macramé wall hanging is the easiest way to do it. Unlike framed art which can feel rigid, the soft cotton cords bring an organic, relaxed element indoors.

props.caption: A large over-the-bed macramé piece serves as an excellent focal point.

cons: Not ideal for humid areas like bathrooms
